versos.grego: Ὁμοίως γυναῖκες, ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν, ἵνα καὶ εἴ τινες ἀπειθοῦσιν τῷ λόγῳ, διὰ τῆς τῶν γυναικῶν ἀναστροφῆς ἄνευ λόγου κερδηθήσονται,

controles.web: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;
controles.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
controles.livre: Semelhantemente vós, esposas, estejais sujeitas aos próprios maridos, para que, ainda que alguns não obedeçam à Palavra, por meio do comportamento das esposas, sem palavra, sejam ganhos,

versos.grego: ἐποπτεύσαντες τὴν ἐν φόβῳ ἁγνὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
controles.kjv: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
controles.livre: quando eles observarem o vosso comportamento puro e com temor.

versos.grego: ὧν ἔστω οὐχ ὁ ἔξωθεν ἐμπλοκῆς τριχῶν καὶ περιθέσεως χρυσίων ἢ ἐνδύσεως ἱματίων κόσμος,

controles.web: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;
controles.kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
controles.livre: A vossa beleza não seja a exterior, como tranças de cabelos, joias de ouro, ou vestuário,

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὁ κρυπτὸς τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος ἐν τῷ ἀφθάρτῳ τοῦ πραέως καὶ ἡσυχίου πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ πολυτελές.

controles.web: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.
controles.kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
controles.livre: mas sim, a pessoa interior no coração, o embelezamento incorruptível de um espírito manso e tranquilo, que é precioso diante de Deus.

versos.grego: οὕτως γάρ ποτε καὶ αἱ ἅγιαι γυναῖκες αἱ ἐλπίζουσαι εἰς Θεὸν ἐκόσμουν ἑαυτάς, ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν,

controles.web: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
controles.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
controles.livre: Pois assim também se embelezavam antigamente as mulheres santas, que esperavam em Deus, e eram sujeitas aos seus maridos.

versos.grego: ὡς Σάρρα ὑπήκουσεν τῷ Ἀβραάμ, κύριον αὐτὸν καλοῦσα· ἧς ἐγενήθητε τέκνα ἀγαθοποιοῦσαι καὶ μὴ φοβούμεναι μηδεμίαν πτόησιν.

controles.web: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
controles.kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
controles.livre: Dessa maneira Sara obedecia a Abraão, chamando-lhe de senhor. Vós sois filhas dela se fizerdes o bem e não temerdes espanto algum.

versos.grego: Οἱ ἄνδρες ὁμοίως συνοικοῦντες κατὰ γνῶσιν ὡς ἀσθενεστέρῳ σκεύει τῷ γυναικείῳ, ἀπονέμοντες τιμήν ὡς καὶ συνκληρονόμοις χάριτος ζωῆς, εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐνκόπτεσθαι τὰς προσευχὰς ὑμῶν.

controles.web: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.
controles.kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
controles.livre: Semelhantemente vós maridos, convivei com elas com entendimento, dando honra à mulher, como a vaso mais fraco, como sendo elas e vós juntamente herdeiros da graça da vida; a fim de que as vossas orações não sejam impedidas.

versos.grego: Τὸ δὲ τέλος πάντες ὁμόφρονες, συμπαθεῖς, φιλάδελφοι, εὔσπλαγχνοι, ταπεινόφρονες,

controles.web: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tender hearted, courteous,
controles.kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
controles.livre: E por fim, sede todos de uma mesma mentalidade, compassivos, tenhais amor pelos irmãos, e sede misericordiosos e benevolentes.

versos.grego: μὴ ἀποδιδόντες κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἢ λοιδορίαν ἀντὶ λοιδορίας, τοὐναντίον δὲ εὐλογοῦντες, ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο ἐκλήθητε ἵνα εὐλογίαν κληρονομήσητε.

controles.web: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.
controles.kjv: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
controles.livre: Não retribuais o mal com mal, ou insulto com insulto; ao contrário, bendizei, pois para isto fostes chamados, para que herdeis a bênção.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ θέλων ζωὴν ἀγαπᾶν καὶ ἰδεῖν ἡμέρας ἀγαθὰς παυσάτω τὴν γλῶσσαν ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ χείλη τοῦ μὴ λαλῆσαι δόλον,

controles.web: For,  “He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.
controles.kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
controles.livre: Pois: quem quer amar a vida e ver dias bons, refreie sua língua do mal, e que seus lábios não falem engano.

versos.grego: ἐκκλινάτω δὲ ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποιησάτω ἀγαθόν, ζητησάτω εἰρήνην καὶ διωξάτω αὐτήν·

controles.web: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
controles.kjv: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
controles.livre: Afaste-se do mal, e faça o bem; busque a paz, e siga-a.

versos.grego: ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ὦτα αὐτοῦ εἰς δέησιν αὐτῶν, πρόσωπον δὲ Κυρίου ἐπὶ ποιοῦντας κακά.

controles.web: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
controles.kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
controles.livre: Porque os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os justos, e seus ouvidos atentos às suas orações; mas a face do Senhor é contra os que fazem o mal.

versos.grego: Καὶ τίς ὁ κακώσων ὑμᾶς ἐὰν τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ ζηλωταὶ γένησθε;

controles.web: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?
controles.kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
controles.livre: E quem vos fará mal se fordes zelosos do bem?

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ πάσχοιτε διὰ δικαιοσύνην, μακάριοι. τὸν δὲ φόβον αὐτῶν μὴ φοβηθῆτε μηδὲ ταραχθῆτε,

controles.web: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
controles.kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
controles.livre: Porém, mesmo se sofrerdes por causa da justiça, benditos  sois. Não tenhais medo deles, nem vos perturbeis.

versos.grego: Κύριον δὲ τὸν Χριστὸν ἁγιάσατε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, ἕτοιμοι ἀεὶ πρὸς ἀπολογίαν παντὶ τῷ αἰτοῦντι ὑμᾶς λόγον περὶ τῆς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐλπίδος,

controles.web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:
controles.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
controles.livre: Mas santificai a Cristo  como Senhor em vossos corações; e estai sempre preparados para responder com mansidão e respeito a todo aquele que vos pedir a razão da esperança que há em vós,

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ μετὰ πραΰτητος καὶ φόβου, συνείδησιν ἔχοντες ἀγαθήν, ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλεῖσθε καταισχυνθῶσιν οἱ ἐπηρεάζοντες ὑμῶν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστροφήν.

controles.web: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
controles.kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
controles.livre: tendo uma boa consciência; para que, naquilo que sois malfalados, os que insultam o vosso bom comportamento em Cristo sejam envergonhados.

versos.grego: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἀγαθοποιοῦντας, εἰ θέλοι τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ, πάσχειν ἢ κακοποιοῦντας.

controles.web: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
controles.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
controles.livre: Pois é melhor que sofrais fazendo o bem, se assim a vontade de Deus quer, do que fazendo o mal.

versos.grego: ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἅπαξ περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπέθανεν, δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων, ἵνα ὑμᾶς προσαγάγῃ τῷ Θεῷ, θανατωθεὶς μὲν σαρκὶ ζωοποιηθεὶς δὲ πνεύματι·

controles.web: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
controles.kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
controles.livre: Porque também Cristo morreu uma vez pelos pecados, o justo pelos injustos; para que vos levasse a Deus. Ele estava , de fato, morto na carne, mas vivificado pelo Espírito,

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ καὶ τοῖς ἐν φυλακῇ πνεύμασιν πορευθεὶς ἐκήρυξεν,

controles.web: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
controles.kjv: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
controles.livre: no qual ele também foi pregar aos espíritos em prisão.

versos.grego: ἀπειθήσασίν ποτε ὅτε ἀπεξεδέχετο ἡ τοῦ Θεοῦ μακροθυμία ἐν ἡμέραις Νῶε κατασκευαζομένης κιβωτοῦ, εἰς ἣν ὀλίγοι, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ὀκτὼ ψυχαί, διεσώθησαν δι’ ὕδατος.

controles.web: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
controles.kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
controles.livre: Estes são os que antigamente foram rebeldes, quando a paciência de Deus aguardava nos dias de Noé, enquanto era preparada a arca. Nela, poucas almas (isto é, oito) foram salvas por meio da água.

versos.grego: ὃ καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀντίτυπον νῦν σῴζει βάπτισμα, οὐ σαρκὸς ἀπόθεσις ῥύπου ἀλλὰ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς ἐπερώτημα εἰς Θεόν, δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
controles.kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Esta é uma representação do batismo, que agora também vos salva, não como remoção da sujeira do corpo, mas sim como o pedido  de boa consciência a Deus, por meio da ressurreição de Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: ὅς ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ Θεοῦ, πορευθεὶς εἰς οὐρανόν, ὑποταγέντων αὐτῷ ἀγγέλων καὶ ἐξουσιῶν καὶ δυνάμεων.

controles.web: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
controles.kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
controles.livre: Ele está à direita de Deus, depois de haver subido ao céu; e os anjos, as autoridades, e os poderes estão sob o seu comando.
